name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 9 – Am 62
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 9a. Expresses its deepest concern and outrage that organisations such as ENAR and FEMYSO continue to be hosted, legitimised, and granted access to the institutional premises of the EU, despite the extensive and public documentation provided by national intelligence services regarding their direct affiliation with the Muslim Brotherhood network; calls for the removal of ENAR from the EU Transparency Register;
